dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-intensity perimeters forming closed 'O' and open 'C' loops; sharp pixel gradient transition from dark exterior pelt to thin, high-intensity internal borders.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate concentration of small, solid, low-gradient light-colored blobs located primarily on the lateral-posterior region; asymmetrical distribution with localized clustering on the lower-left flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three primary dorsal annuli form a wide-angled obtuse triangle; a secondary group of four high-intensity spots on the lower lateral surface forms an irregular quadrilateral.
